# MyGolfBuddy Copilot Instructions

You are contributing to the MyGolfBuddy project.

Read and follow:

- PROJECT_CHARTER.md
- PROJECT_REQUIREMENTS.md
- ARCHITECTURE.md
- ROADMAP.md

before making design decisions.

---

## Current Development Phase

Phase 1 - MVP

Focus only on:

- Browser geolocation
- Open-Meteo integration
- Golf score calculation
- Mobile-first user interface

---

## Technology Constraints

Use:

- HTML
- CSS
- Vanilla JavaScript

Do not introduce:

- React
- Angular
- Vue
- TypeScript
- Backend services
- Databases

unless explicitly requested.

---

## Design Principles

- Mobile-first
- Responsive
- Clean UI
- Easy to maintain
- Azure compatible

---

## Code Standards

- Modular JavaScript
- Meaningful function names
- No duplicated logic
- Clear comments
- Defensive error handling

---

## Future Integrations

Expected future integrations:

- Google Maps API
- Golf course discovery
- Tee time providers
- Azure Functions

Design code so future integrations can be added without significant refactoring.
